title: Lipitor Korean Atorvastatin Goal Achievement Across Risk Levels Study

sections.abstract:
To evaluate the percentage of Korean dyslipidemic subjects in the total group and each cardiovascular risk group achieving LDL-C target as defined by NCEP ATP Ⅲ criteria at starting doses of 10mg, 20mg and 40mg of atorvastatin after 8 weeks of treatment.

Posted outcomes: Percent of Subjects in the Total and Each Cardiovascular Risk Group Achieving Low Density Lipoprotein-cholesterol (LDL-C) Target After 8 Weeks of Treatment.. timeframe=Week 8. Total=86.0; Low Risk=92.9; Medium Risk=95.5
